A complete miss
Dec 2019
The service was poor as well as the atmosphere of the restaurant, as we were placed in the upper level room. I ordered a Larue beer (45K VND) to start, and the bun cha (149K VND) as my meal. The bun cha was average tasting, but the noodles were out of the fridge cold. 

The others in the group mistakenly ordered Italian and Mexican dishes, not a good idea. Their meals we’re less than appetizing, did not match what the menu stated and they were quite upset about their meals including discussion with the server and Manager to resolve. The Huong Viet Vietnamese Aroma was a complete miss and the worst restaurant on the G Adventures tour.

Vietnamese Aromas for a Tasty Meal
Sep 2019
Lovely vibe to this venue, with a large selection of Vietnamese / Asian / Western meals on offer on their menu.Very tasty dishes too - although the portions could have been a little bit bigger. Reasonably priced - do be mindful that an extra 'food tax' is added to your bill - and this was the only major city in Vietnam where I experienced this extra charge to the bill... Quite a popular location, and well frequented by tourists. Plus it was literally only a 5 mins walk away from our Park View Saigon Hotel - too easy!

Decent food
Nov 2019 • Couples
I agree with a previous review that perhaps having a menu that spans several cuisines including Mexican, Vietnamese, American and Indian means less chance of perfecting dishes. I was given an incorrect main course initially and had to wait for the correct one to be cooked while my partner ate his. The chicken fajitas were tasty but weren’t sizzling or spicy in the way I expected. There was a very large group dining there which may have impacted on the efficiency of the kitchen. I can see how the restaurant would appeal to groups given its capacity and varied menu and the food we had was very acceptable.

Quality establishment
Feb 2019 • Solo
I was staying in the Gia Vien hotel opposite and this place was always busy so I thought it must be a good restaurant and had to try it. That turned out to be the case because I had a very enjoyable meal here. I can't remember what it was called but I had a dish that was a mixture of pork, rice, peanuts and spring rolls. It was delicious, as was the mango salad I ordered to accompany it. I can't remember what I paid exactly but I remember thinking it was great value and if it hadn't of been my last night in Saigon before I left I would have eaten here again.
